channel.title: Ghostex Updates
channel.description: Sparkle appcast for Ghostex macOS releases.

item.description:
# Ghostex 10.38.0
## 10.38.0 - 2026-10-27
**Ghostex 10.38.0 is out.** Codex sessions get a Mode button, the chat's ? pill becomes Chat Resources with every page, form and chart, session links stop picking up unrelated tickets and take links you add by hand, approval cards show one hotkey per row, Claude cloud sessions open as a chat, and Linux gets signed, self-updating AppImages and a working mouse wheel in the Browser.
### 💬 Chat
- **Codex sessions get a Mode button like Claude's** that switches the running session between Ask for approval, Approve for me, Full Access and Read Only, on the computer and the phone. - **The ? pill opens Chat Resources:** every page, question form and chart in the chat, with a dropdown for All, Html, Q&A or Charts, and a row jumps to its card. A form or page can be put off For later, so it stops counting as unanswered. - **Summary mode keeps messages with pages, forms and charts open,** and folds other agents' messages and thread reports into Agent reply. - **Approval and dialog cards show each row's number as the only hotkey hint,** without the extra buttons under the rows, and Show terminal output opens the lines above the prompt on the card itself. On the phone, a dialog with no No row keeps Cancel. - **A tool call reads as done only once it ran:** one waiting for approval, declined or failed reads "Create", "Run" or "Edit". - **A code block's Wrap, Run and Copy buttons are icon-only, with tooltips.** - **Copy Report states the same input-box verdict as the Terminal View light above it.**
### 🔗 Session links
- **Only your own words link a Linear ticket:** IDs in thread reports, other agents' messages, tool output or the agent's replies no longer link unrelated tickets. Ones the session's agent mentions show under Suggested, and an orchestrator's own replies suggest nothing. - **A suggestion's × dismisses it for good, and + adds a PR, issue or Linear ticket by hand:** type `SPX-123`, `#123` or paste a link. - **Suggested shows the 5 newest, with Show all for the rest.** - **Remote sessions show their links in the sidebar card and the top bar.** The sidebar shows a badge by default, on the title's line and gray once every link is merged, and Settings > General > Chat > Show session links in the chat's top bar can hide them.
### ☁️ Claude cloud
- **A Claude cloud session opens as an empty chat:** pick its account, send the first message, and its claude.ai page appears in the chat pane. A Cloud button in the header switches to the terminal, opens or copies the claude.ai link, and starts a copy on another account.
### 🧭 Views and pages
- **Changes: one button on the right of the header picks Whole branch or Uncommitted only,** and picking a file unfolds it and centres it. - **Settings > Extensions opens the extension catalog from the sidebar,** its pages fold under it, and About moves up with the top rows. - **Terminal extensions like Lazygit are easy to open:** an Open row in Quick Access, pinned on install, and Install with Homebrew when the command is missing. - **Inline HTML pages get a centred design that works in dark and light,** with a Dark / Light switch, and their tooltips look like the app's, with your platform's shortcut keys.
### 🐧 Linux
- **The mouse wheel scrolls Browser pages under xfwm4 and other window managers that grab mouse buttons,** and touchpads stay pixel-precise (#338). - **A leftover libcef.so beside the app no longer crashes Ghostex at launch:** it's skipped for the downloaded CEF, and a mismatched CEF shows an error instead (#339). - **AppImages are signed and carry update information,** so AppImage managers such as AppManager show the update link and web page and can update Ghostex. ghostex.dev's Linux downloads add Install with AppManager.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Open Folder on a remote project opens it in Files,** and Open In opens VS Code-family editors and Zed over SSH.
### 📱 On the phone
- **The Sessions screen is drawn like the desktop sidebar,** with Voice, Search, Web and Machines in a bottom bar.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **A tool whose version check never answers no longer stalls Settings > Integrations:** it's stopped after 5 seconds and the rest of the list shows (#336). - **Restoring a Space or workspace keeps sleeping sessions asleep,** thanks to @suatkocar. - **Anonymous usage stats (Settings' existing opt-out) now include which built-in and official extensions are on and which views are opened.**

# Ghostex 10.37.0
## 10.37.0 - 2026-10-27
**Ghostex 10.37.0 is out.** Sessions stuck on a permission prompt now show red everywhere, Settings > Hotkeys gets a Terminal focused section, Linux gets an AppImage, remote computers get a Machine picker for agent CLIs and integrations, Claude and Codex dialogs can be answered from the chat again, and phone pairing works for phones that couldn't scan.
### 🔴 Waiting on you
- **A session stuck on a permission prompt shows a red dot,** on its row, its coordinator's crew badge, the Threads pill and the project, section, Space and computer headers, on the computer and the phone. Notifications say "Waiting for your approval", and `ghostex sessions` prints "waiting for approval". - **A coordinator's crew badge reads red, then light blue, then orange,** so a thread waiting on you shows ahead of working ones. - **The Threads pill shows one corner dot per state:** amber while threads run, red or pink when one waits on you, overlapping when both.
### ⌨️ Hotkeys
- **Settings > Hotkeys has a Terminal focused section,** so a key can do one thing in a terminal and another everywhere else, and the same key can be set in both. Keys you changed keep working in a terminal until you set its terminal row. - **Windows and Linux: plain Ctrl keys reach the program in a terminal.** In a terminal Ghostex uses Ghostty's keys (Ctrl+Shift+V pastes, Ctrl+Shift+C copies); outside a terminal your keys work as before. - **Unfocus Terminal and Focus Last Terminal** (Cmd+Shift+M, Ctrl+Shift+M on Windows and Linux) take the keyboard out of a terminal and back again. - **Terminal Copy and Select All, Browser History, Reload Page and Sleep's second key can be changed in Settings,** and `ghostex settings hotkeys` takes `--terminal`. - **Export Transcript has no default key,** which ends its clash with Expand View Panel on Windows and Linux. Set one in Settings > Hotkeys (Handoff / Export).
### 💬 Chat
- **Codex's questions can be answered from the chat again** with Codex 0.161 and later, Skip included, and the chat no longer locks while Codex's question editor is open. Codex's "conversation open elsewhere" screen offers Continue here again. - **Claude's Ready to code card shows the whole plan and every choice,** and the "We recommend compacting earlier" dialog can be answered from the chat, with Smaller and Larger for its size. - **The sign-in error card gets Reconnect,** and an account whose login expired shows Needs sign-in. - **Two one-line cards in a row are always the same distance apart,** on the computer and the phone.
### 🤖 Claude
- **Claude cloud sessions open in the chat view:** type the first message, then its claude.ai page appears in the chat pane. Their state and replies come from claude.ai. On the phone, a tap opens claude.ai and a long press offers Open Terminal. - **Claude is a built-in extension, off by default,** that opens claude.ai over the work area from a sidebar button, with a bar to switch between your saved Claude accounts' sign-ins. Turn it on in Settings > Extensions > Store > Features.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Settings > Agents and Integrations get a Machine picker** that installs and updates agent CLIs, skills and tools on another computer, including Fast Computer & Browser Use and SpaceO on a remote Mac. The phone shows each computer's agent CLIs and skills on its Edit screen.
### 🪟 Windows
- **gxserver no longer quits every few seconds** after updating to 10.36.0 (#312), thanks to @DaveW001 for finding the cause. - **Hooks and skills link without Developer Mode:** a refused link becomes a junction or a copy, and a failed link puts the agent's own folder back. Settings > Agents and Integrations recommend Developer Mode for a Windows machine. - **A new browser tab with glass no longer shows a stale frame** while its page loads.
### 🐧 Linux
- **Linux releases include an AppImage** for x64 and ARM64: download it, make it executable and run it.
### 📱 On the phone
- **Pairing works when the phone can't scan:** Copy as text sits under Show QR on the computer, and the QR is larger, black on white and easier to scan. The phone reads every code a recent computer shows, and says when a code needs a newer app. - **Settings no longer crashes on iOS** when no update is pending, and a broken Settings section shows a Try Again card instead of closing the app.
### 🧭 Views and pages
- **Keep views loaded** (Settings > General, off by default) keeps side panel views loaded across project and Space switches until their Auto Sleep time, thanks to @suatkocar. - **Closing or hiding a side panel tab selects the tab next to it,** thanks to @suatkocar. - **A page's notification brings back the tab that posted it,** in its own project, thanks to @suatkocar. - **Code view: arrow, Home/End and Page keys no longer type control characters into files** on macOS (#326). - **Files: Annotate's copied feedback names the file's project path** instead of "srcdoc" (#329).
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Ghostex no longer leaves the programs it starts behind as zombie processes** (the completion sound, Open In, editors), which piled up over a long day (#334), thanks to @suatkocar. - **Codex sessions start when Superset is installed;** the two tools' codex wrappers no longer call each other (#325). - **The OpenAI voice agent starts with many projects,** and voice session errors reach `ghostex logs` (#331). - **`ghostex browser mcp` answers Claude Code and Codex.** - **Feedback's Start Agent says plainly why an agent couldn't start.** - **Terminals get Ghostty's latest fixes,** including a fix to its zsh integration, and Ghostex is drawn through Zed's newest Metal renderer. - **Background pages get the Browser panel's size** and close with their project.

# Ghostex 10.36.0
## 10.36.0 - 2026-10-26
**Ghostex 10.36.0 is out.** Ghostex moves to the newest GPUI, Ghostty, Chromium and VS Code, uses far less CPU while accessibility tools run, gets open files, VS Code windows and Browser pages as tabs, background pages for agents in other projects, a Session details panel for every chat agent, separate accounts for people who share a Codex Business workspace, and a round of fixes for remote computers, Linux installs and the phone.
### ⚡ Faster and newer
- **Ghostex is drawn by the newest GPUI (Zed's latest, GPUI Fast and GPUI Kit 0.8),** so idle CPU drops from about 26% to about 4% while accessibility tools are running. - **Lists and menus scroll with macOS-style bounce.** - **Terminals run on Ghostty's late-October code and the newest zmx,** and sessions that are already running keep going through the update. - **The built-in browser runs Chromium 156,** October's security update. After updating, Ghostex downloads its Chromium runtime once more the first time a browser view opens. - **The VS Code view moves to VS Code 1.143.1.** - **Rendering and window errors are written to Ghostex's log,** so a problem like a window that stops updating can be diagnosed.
### 💬 Chat
- **Every chat agent gets a Session details panel** with Environment, Context, Skills and Changes, Codex and OpenCode show every card their data supports, and empty cards are hidden. - **Each chat remembers whether its Session details panel is open,** and switching chats no longer turns the floating card off for every chat. - **The Prompt Editor shortcut (Ctrl+G) in a chat box opens the chat box's maximized editor** and restores it on the next press; the terminal view keeps opening the Prompt Editor. - **Comments and notes sent to a chat box show at once and add to what's there** instead of replacing earlier pills or typed text. - **Add to Session Context adds the file to the chat box** when the session is shown as a chat. - **A failed command row no longer shows "Exit code 1" after its title;** the red title and cross already say it failed, and the full output stays in the expanded row. - **Ghostex dismisses Claude's self-drafted feedback card, the chat gets Copy Report,** and a Claude panel's selected tab is readable. - **Claude's context breakdown waits for the conversation's first message** instead of failing, and a real failure shows Claude's own message.
### 📂 Files and VS Code
- **Files can show open files as tabs above the document** (Settings, off by default), with keyboard switching on the tab row, thanks to @suatkocar. - **VS Code windows can show as tabs above the VS Code page** (advanced setting, off by default), thanks to @suatkocar. - **Web links from the VS Code view open where Open links in says,** and on the project's remote computer for remote projects. - **Cmd+Shift+F opens Search in Files anywhere in the Files view,** including the file list and its filter field, and stays Find Prompts everywhere else. - **Tab tooltips show below their tab** instead of covering the tab beside it. - **The VS Code view's terminals get their fonts without a permission bar;** outside sites still ask. - **`ghostex open` follows your File opening setting for every file type,** and `ghostex edit` on a file outside your projects opens it in the project on screen instead of adding a project.
### 🧭 Sessions and views
- **Session groups from the CLI,** plus `create-session --group-id` and `--cwd`, thanks to @suatkocar. - **A deleted Linear ticket no longer leaves every session's Linear links on "Loading…",** thanks to @suatkocar. - **With Dim sleeping sessions on, a session that sleeps right after finishing a turn dims like the others,** and a view whose Auto Sleep is Off is no longer slept by the awake cap, so VS Code keeps its terminals and place, thanks to @suatkocar. - **A view hidden in one project comes back to its own place in the tab bar,** not at the end, thanks to @suatkocar. - **Hiding or turning off the view on screen shows the tab beside it** instead of closing the side panel, thanks to @suatkocar. - **An orchestrator's tree line in the sidebar runs on past a nested orchestrator's threads** instead of breaking beside them, on the computer and the phone, and a selected card no longer shifts by a pixel, thanks to @suatkocar. - **Next and Previous Session work while the VS Code view, a Files preview, Work or an extension view has the keyboard.**
### 🌍 Browser
- **The Browser can show its pages in their own row under one Browser tab** (Settings > General > Tools > Browser > Show pages in their own row, off by default), with arrow keys and Delete on the row, thanks to @suatkocar. - **A page an agent opens for a project that isn't on screen goes to that project's Browser in the background:** the project you're looking at stays as it is, a notice says where the page went, and the agent can use the page right away, thanks to @suatkocar. - **Clicking a PR, issue, Linear or Work chip on another project's session takes you to that project** and opens the page in its Browser with that workspace's sign-ins, thanks to @suatkocar.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Connecting to a remote computer logs in once,** so each start or reconnect costs two SSH logins instead of seven or eight. - **Remote tunnels stop when Ghostex quits,** and a tunnel left behind by a crash is stopped at the next launch. - **Interrupting OpenCode ends its running shells,** and deleting a session, project or worktree drops its queued prompts.
### 👥 Accounts
- **Codex logins from different people in one ChatGPT Business workspace are separate accounts,** each with its own name and settings, and existing accounts keep theirs (needs codex-swap 0.3.2 or later). - **Windows: Claude account switching uses Claude Swap 0.28,** still with shared history.
### 🐧 Linux
- **The setup wizard's Browser Use and Computer Use steps work on AUR, deb and rpm installs,** which ship `ghostex` as a small script Ghostex now recognises.
### 📄 Pages
- **A page's answers keep trying to send and save while Ghostex can't be reached,** on the computer and the phone. - **A page published earlier gets today's built-in page script whenever it opens,** so it picks up later fixes.
### 📱 On the phone
- **The phone app moves to Expo SDK 58 and React Native 0.88.** - **A page open on the phone keeps its address and its typed answers through a dropped link.** - **On the Machines screen, a long machine name no longer covers Edit** when a row is swiped open. - **The chip bar scrolls instead of overflowing,** its sheets use the chat's text size, and bottom sheets fade their backdrop in place while they slide up.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **macOS: closing a focused chat menu or the maximized chat box no longer quits the app** through the Touch Bar, thanks to @WangAxerold. - **A Chromium-style new tab (DevTools or the + button) no longer quits the app.**

# Ghostex 10.35.0
## 10.35.0 - 2026-10-25
**Ghostex 10.35.0 is out.** A new Changes view reviews a project's diff with line comments for the agent, revert and a commit bar, the Code Editor view is now called VS Code, Handoff to Remote moves a session to another computer's project, and the Session details panel, Files compare and remote starts get a round of fixes.
### 🔍 Changes view
- **A Changes view shows a project's diff against main or its uncommitted changes,** in Unified or Split, with word-level highlights and Files-sized text, and it works for projects on remote computers too. - **Comment on any line and the comment joins the chat box as a pill,** one pill per comment, and the agent gets the file, the lines and your comment when you send. The chat shows the same pills, and the lines stay marked Sent until they change. - **Revert a whole file or a single hunk, and mark files viewed** as you go; a file's buttons show on hover and the file count opens a jump-to-file menu. - **A commit bar with an agent picker commits what you picked:** Commit, Commit & Push, Commit, Push & Create PR, Multiple Commits or Merge into main, and leaving the message empty lets the agent write it. Only agents that run on your computer are offered. - **It replaces the old commit review window,** so every place that opened that window now opens Changes on the matching scope. - **It is on by default, right after Files** in the view picker, the + menu and the Store. - **Settings > General > File opening > Open file changes in picks Changes view or VS Code** for Review all and the Session details Changes card. - **The phone gets a read-only Changes screen** with the same diff, from a session's ⋯ menu or a long-press on its row.
### 💻 VS Code view
- **The Code Editor view is now called VS Code** everywhere, with the VS Code icon, and the outside editor in File opening menus is called VS Code app.
### 🤝 Handoff
- **Handoff to Remote hands a session to another computer's project:** pick the computer and project (the one with the same repository is preselected), clone the repository there if it is missing, and see a note when the branches differ. The original session keeps running. - **Picking another agent's model hands off to exactly that agent and model,** and Handoff says why when no agent of that kind is set up. - **The chat's … menu works on remote sessions:** Handoff/Export, Fork, Full Reload, Rename, Close After Done and Note.
### 🧩 Session details panel
- **Clicking a skill opens that skill,** in Agents Hub for your own skills and as its SKILL.md for a project or plugin skill. - **The details button stays on the last chat you focused,** even while you work in the sidebar, Files, the Commands panel or another view. - **The docked panel slides in and out** like the side panel, without the chat re-wrapping mid-slide.
### 📂 Files
- **When a file changes on disk while you edit it, Compare shows the difference right inside Files,** with Back to editing, Keep mine and Take theirs.
### 🤖 Agents
- **A custom agent whose command is a built-in agent, such as omp, starts on a remote computer as that agent,** and one that matches no built-in agent says how to fix it. - **Antigravity chats no longer show agy's system messages,** each turn closes after agy's last reply, and agy 1.4.7's file edits, timers and task checks show as proper tool rows. - **A finished background command shows as a tool call inside its turn** for every agent, instead of a separate card.
### 🌐 Startup and remote computers
- **Ghostex no longer shows a false startup report** when another start of gxserver got there first. - **macOS: when a remote computer starts gxserver over SSH, it keeps Keychain access,** so connectors stay signed in.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Floating controls are solid, so text behind them no longer shows through:** the chat's command bar, the picture viewer's buttons in the chat and Files, and the composer's thumbnail remove button. - **Tooltips across the app go away when their click opens a window** instead of staying up over it. - **Windows: clicking a file link in a WSL session's chat opens the file** instead of saying the project folder is unavailable, thanks to @omegafrog.

# Ghostex 10.34.0
## 10.34.0 - 2026-10-25
**Ghostex 10.34.0 is out.** Updating no longer stalls when every session has to restart, Files searches the whole project with Cmd+Shift+F and finds text in any file with Cmd+F, session links stay within the project's own repositories, OpenCode chats follow the terminal's model, and Claude sessions get a Session details panel in beta.
### 🔄 Updating
- **Updating no longer stalls when every session has to restart:** after the 10.33.0 update, a few dozen sessions could hold Ghostex at "starting" for minutes, and now the switch-over takes a couple of seconds, on macOS, Linux and Windows with WSL.
### 📂 Files
- **Cmd+Shift+F searches every file in the project in a Search view like VS Code's** (Ctrl+Shift+F on Windows and Linux), with match case, whole word and regex, files to include and exclude, results grouped by file, F4 to step through them and Esc back to the editor. - **Project search skips what isn't your code:** it follows .gitignore, leaves out dependencies, build output, vendored code and large or binary files, and keeps its notes behind an info icon so the results get more room. - **Cmd+F finds text in code and text files** with the same panel Markdown files have: whole word, match case, replace and a match count, with every match highlighted. - **Long Markdown files scroll smoothly,** several times faster per frame than before. - **A filter button in the file list's search box shows only HTML, Markdown, Excalidraw, image or video files,** one type or several at once, with the folders that hold them.
### 🔗 Session links
- **Ghostex only suggests and adds links from the project's own repositories** (its origin, plus upstream for a fork), and links from other repositories added earlier are dropped unless you pinned or added them yourself; Linear tickets are unaffected. - **Hovering a link shows the sidebar's see-through tooltip right under it,** with the link's title and a pull request's branch, never cut off by the links card.
### 💡 Tooltips
- **Tooltips across the sidebar and Files use the same see-through bubble and stay inside the window,** from session card and project header buttons to the Search view's info note.
### 🧩 Session details panel
- **A Session details panel shows what a Claude session is working with,** beside the chat when there is room and as a floating card when there isn't: where it runs and on which Claude account (by email), how full its context is with Claude's own breakdown, its task list, connectors, skills, memory files, changes against main with Commit or Create PR, and background commands with a stop button. - **It is a beta, on by default:** click the context ring at the top right of the window to show or hide it, and turn it off in Settings > Extensions > Store. Each part shows a pulsing placeholder while it loads, and clicking a skill opens it in Agents Hub. Claude sessions only for now.
### 🎙️ Voice
- **The voice agent is an extension you can turn off** in Settings > Extensions: its button leaves the top of the window, its hotkeys and call entries go away on the computer and the phone, and Dictate keeps working. Its settings now live under Settings > Extensions > Voice agent.
### 🤖 OpenCode
- **An OpenCode chat shows the same model as its terminal,** and messages sent from the chat use it. - **Ghostex starts OpenCode 2 even when an older OpenCode comes first on your PATH,** and when OpenCode 2 is missing or can't start, the chat says why and offers Install OpenCode 2 or Restart on OpenCode 2. - **OpenCode's long thoughts open in full** instead of being cut off on one line, on the computer, in the browser and on the phone. - **Windows: OpenCode installs and updates from Settings,** using Git for Windows.
### 🌐 Remote machines
- **A remote machine's connection notice floats over the top of its list,** so the rows never move: a failed machine shows its reason with Reconnect and Remote Settings and turns only the tab's cloud icon red, and connecting shows a spinner and a one-line pill. - **The notice's × shrinks it to a pill that keeps the red mark** and opens the card again on click, and the phone shows the same notice.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **macOS: Option and Shift with the arrows, Delete and Forward Delete edit text in web page fields** instead of typing a blank.

# Ghostex 10.33.0
## 10.33.0 - 2026-10-24
**Ghostex 10.33.0 is out.** Sessions keep their pull requests, issues and Linear tickets at hand as links, a voice call can focus on one session with a push-to-talk button, shell commands in chat run in a terminal with one click, and new sessions start reliably while crashes on Windows and macOS are fixed.
### 🔗 Session links
- **A session keeps links to any number of pull requests, GitHub issues and Linear tickets,** shown as chips beside its title, a line under its sidebar card and a list with review status and checks, on the computer and the phone. - **Each link shows what it is by its icon** (pull request, draft or closed pull request, issue, Linear ticket or branch), and hovering one shows its full title and details. - **The links list leads with open work and folds merged and closed links into their own section,** every section folds with a chevron, and the list grows up to half the window. - **Pin a session's main links** so they lead every list and always show in the sidebar; a pinned link can't be removed until you unpin it. - **A removed link can be undone or restored later,** links Ghostex suggests show their titles and states, and a session with only suggestions shows a quiet badge that opens them. - **Session links show under every session card by default:** Settings > Sidebar > Session links in the sidebar starts at Always and also offers Selected session, Badge, Open work only and Off. - **Hovering a session in the sidebar opens its links in a floating card,** and +N opens the full list. - **Links stay fresh without slowing Ghostex down:** each repository is read from GitHub in one go, idle sessions refresh every 30 minutes and whenever you open them, and link titles survive restarts. - **On the phone, a chat shows its session's links in a strip under the header,** session rows follow the sidebar setting, and a long press on a link opens its details with Pin and Remove.
### 💬 Chat
- **Shell commands in replies run with one click:** code blocks get Run in terminal and inline commands get Copy or Paste in terminal, using the project's Commands panel terminal, on the computer and the phone. - **The picture viewer moves through every picture in the chat** with the arrow keys, edge buttons and a counter, and with swipes on the phone. - **Every agent's tool calls read like Claude's:** a Codex command says what ran and a failed one leads with its exit code, and thinking is a slim row that opens on click. - **Settings > Chat > Open chat pages in picks Popup, Files or System browser** for the pages agents show in chat. - **Question forms show an info icon instead of the sentence about skipped questions,** on the computer, the phone and pages, and a page's choices follow the order of the variants shown above them. - **The running dot sits in the pill's corner like the questions dot,** and the questions pill shows its count instead of a question mark. - **Long chats use much less memory:** each chat now keeps its drawn messages once instead of twice, tens of megabytes less on a chat with a few thousand messages. - **A session keeps the Terminal or Chat view you picked for it** when it wakes, resumes or comes back after a restart.
### 🎙️ Voice
- **A voice call can be about one session:** start it from a chat's menu, or a session's long press on the phone, and widen it to all sessions when you need to. - **Push-to-talk gets a hold button beside Mute,** plus Space and a Hold to Talk hotkey and a Stop pill; on the phone, sliding off the button cancels, it buzzes as you press, and the call notification gets a Talk button. - **Long voice replies read as short paragraphs,** a run of the same tool shows as one row, and rows get more room. - **The computer asks Keep the call or Hang up and call when a call is already open on another computer,** like the phone does.
### 🗂️ Sidebar
- **A project's session groups sit indented under it with a tree line and a folder icon, and fold with it,** on the computer and the phone, thanks to @suatkocar (#286, ghostex-mobile#2). - **A session can leave a session group again:** drag it onto another group or its project's list, or use Advanced > Move to Group and Remove from Group, thanks to @suatkocar (#284). - **A folded orchestrator shows its threads' overlapping status dots:** blue means a thread finished and clears when you open the orchestrator, and pink means a thread is waiting on you. - **The sidebar toggle keeps its place beside the window buttons** when the top row is wider than the sidebar (#288). - **A computer tab's status circles sit below its label** instead of pushing the icon and name aside, on the computer and the phone. - **An awake session's agent icon is brighter at rest,** and Collapse All skips hidden session groups.
### 🧭 Orchestrators
- **Every message an orchestrator sends a thread reminds it of its title,** so threads rename themselves to their latest task. - **Messages between agents always say who sent them,** and a thread can't message its own orchestrator in the middle of a turn.
### 🧩 Issues Workflow
- **Work mode becomes Issues Workflow, on for every project once a Linear API key or `gh` is set up,** with Title sessions by their branch and Offer Clean up when a PR merges as their own settings, on the computer and the phone.
### 🌐 Remote access
- **The pairing QR is a ghostex.dev link,** so the phone's own camera opens Ghostex and pairs, on Android and iPhone. - **Settings > Remote has Easy Connect, Tailscale, Remote machines and Advanced tabs,** each showing its status on the tab strip, and the pairing QR waits behind Show QR, which opens a larger popup.
### 📂 Files
- **Pictures zoom with pinch, keys and header buttons, tall ones open at the view's width, and a click opens a full-window viewer;** on the phone, a double tap switches between screen width and actual size.
### 📱 On the phone
- **This release's phone features come with the phone app update, not over the air,** so install the new app to get session links, voice calls about one session, push-to-talk, Run in terminal and the rest. - **Android pastes and drops images into the chat box,** and the chat box's pills stop flickering while you type.
### 🪟 Windows
- **Creating a Codex session no longer crashes the background service (#289),** a session step that crashes is skipped instead of taking the service down, and leftover session terminals and helpers are ended.
### 🔄 Updating
- **Installing this version restarts your running sessions once on macOS, Linux and Windows with WSL.** Agents come back on their own, but anything they had in flight at that moment is lost, so update at a quiet time.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **New sessions start reliably (#290):** Ghostex checks the launch command, types nothing before the agent's input box is ready, and sends a model only to its own agent, so Codex no longer opens blank and Claude no longer gets a Codex model. - **macOS: picking a model or closing the Feedback window no longer quits the app (#291).** - **Kanban card text fields take clicks again when the board has its own window (#287).** - **Codex sessions idle for a week show their chat and resume again** after Codex compresses their history. - **A session whose account was removed moves to a working account when it wakes or is restored,** and an account refusal shows one toast naming the session, agent and account, with Open Accounts. - **Arrows, Home/End, Page Up/Down and Forward Delete edit text in web pages** instead of typing a blank. - **Agents Hub: the Sync all agents panel is opaque and lists only the groups with changes,** and an empty plan just says everything is in sync. - **The floating Capture button keeps up with a fast drag.** - **Settings hides rows this computer can't use until you search for them,** so a Mac with Read aloud off no longer says it can't speak.
